title: MUniverse Caillet et al 2023
description: A BIDS-formatted high-density surface EMG (HDsEMG) dataset from six healthy male participants performing trapezoidal isometric dorsiflexion contractions at 30% and 50% of maximal voluntary contraction. Signals were recorded from the right tibialis anterior with four 64-channel electrode grids (256 electrodes) together with force measurements. The dataset supports studies of motor unit identification and electrode grid design.
methods_description: Participants sat with the hips flexed at 30 degrees and the dominant foot fixed to a dynamometer pedal at 30 degrees plantarflexion. Each performed two randomized trapezoidal contractions (30% and 50% MVC) with linear ramps at 5% MVC per second and a 15-20 s plateau, separated by 120 s of rest. Four 64-channel grids were placed side by side over the tibialis anterior after skin preparation. Force was recorded with a load cell using the same acquisition system as the HD-EMG.
